title: LOG is a kb type: private observed signals cited beside facts
goal: Every root may keep a _logs.csv that the public projection never carries, with kb/_self/_logs.csv holding the project's own rows; an internal fact or article cites a row with a LOG tag; a tool proposes a row from the ops store and the operator confirms it; a row stays active until its context is invalidated; lookups show active LOG lines as evidence beside facts, never counted toward coverage and never the answer alone.
